text:
kevin: Found a KMS-admin entitlement that slipped through the quarterly sweep logic. principal=svc-query-cache@proj-data has KMSKeyAdmin and no up-to-date owner record. kicking off a thread to triage and decide if we need an exception. cc @ana @devops

ana: can you paste the last grant event? curious if it's a long-lived key or recent change.

kevin: logs: ```2026-03-25T11:09:12Z audit: grant KMSKeyAdmin principal=svc-query-cache@proj-data performed_by=svc-deployer@infra reason=deploy-temp token=tt-12ab```

devops: that token looks service-issued. if it was from a deploy helper maybe it leaked elevated scope. which deploy PR created the helper?

kevin: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/deploy/PR/678 - change added request_kms_admin helper.

maria: compliance-bot, any immediate flags if we demote this principal? it's used in a cached query pipeline for billing reports.

compliance-bot: POLICY_CHECK: demoting svc-query-cache from KMSKeyAdmin may break encrypted report exports; require FinanceSec approval and a 48h manual verification runbook if demotion occurs. Recommend manual review before auto-prune.

audits-bot: EVIDENCE: last_owner=tom (removed 2025-12-11), okta_session_refs=[os-998f], recent_actions=[KMSKeyAdmin grant 2026-03-25, role attach admin:write 2026-01-07].

ana: sounds like owner attr drift. we should ownerproof but treat KMS cases as manual. propose: 1) ownerproof email to last known owner+team lead 2) temp-lock KMS admin actions (allow read-only) 3) if no ownerproof within 5 days escalate to FinanceSec and infra for manual handback.

kevin: +1. I'll craft the ownerproof email and queue the evidence bundle to incident-ops/access-review-2026-q2.

devops: I'll prepare a safe rollback for the helper in PR 678 and add a canary flag to disable request_kms_admin fallback.

maria: please ensure we tag this principal for the next admin-entitlement cleanup but mark KMS-sensitive so it requires manual sign-off.

tom: FYI I was the prior owner but my team offboarded in Dec; i'll accept the ownerproof and then submit a handback to infra to convert svc-query-cache to limited decrypt-only role if that's acceptable to Finance.

kevin: nice. action owners: kevin (ownerproof + evidence), devops (PR rollback/canary), ana (monitor for any KMS admin spikes), tom (ownerproof response + handback plan), compliance-bot to log exception path. we'll reconvene in 24h with status.

audits-bot: LOGGED: evidence_id=eid-8342 stored in s3://redwood-security/access-review/2026-q2/eid-8342.csv retention=1y.

maria: noted. one more ask  can we add a billing-run verification to the post-demotion checklist so Finance can greenlight?

compliance-bot: ACK: added requirement finance-verification to exception path.

kevin: closing this triage for now; will post ownerproof results and any rollback actions in this thread. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
